box-header.title: The edge cluster could not be read

label.text: A local node links to each live member at its link address, and reaches a member with none only through the address it paired with, where any member may answer. Set edge_link_url on every member, each to its own public https address (a port when it is not 443).

Front nodes on one database with one .env, so one link key, that each take links. A node behind them pairs once and links to every live member at its link address. Each needs the address records of the names it answers.

Edge nodes on one database with one .env, so one link key, that each take links. Every member's answer to a local node lists the live ones with their link addresses, and the local node links to each and takes work from each; Clients shows the links to this member. Without a front node, publish an address record, an MX record and the SRV records for each member.
No front node. Behind one (conf/full-stack), pair a member with it on Edge Node and copy the front_node lines of its .env to the other members.
One member: local nodes dial it at the address they paired with, so it needs no link address. Set edge_link_url on each member before a second one starts.

default-field.title: SIP trunks
default-field.tooltip: One member registers the trunks, the holder of a lock row the members renew; it moves to another member when that one stops. Every member places and takes calls

label.text: ${front.name}: this node and every other member of its cluster dial it with the shared .env, as one pairing there, and give it the names they serve. The front balances them over the live members and passes each member's own link name through to it. Media, TURN and SIP are not through the front: they are at each member's own address. Unpair front is on Edge Node.

default-field.title: Address
default-field.tooltip: front_node_url, or the front member's own link address
